inputs.text: The “No Kings” figures are coming from the organisers, not an independently verified count: 8 million people at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states, with authorities offering no official number. That silence isn’t reassuring—it leaves the organisers’ headline free to do its job, projecting a surge of opposition without anyone having to prove the scale. And the “about one million more participants and 600 more events” than in October reads like momentum-building, not neutral accounting. Whether the crowds were genuine, managed, or both, the people shaping the story benefit from presenting dissent as a sweeping national wave. Don’t mistake a polished narrative for proof of what the country thinks.
